seed: Objects of type `marker` under action ACTION6 with touching neighbours [hazard,hit,wall] show mixed outcomes: gone x1, x,y x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: the presence, type or relative position of a neighbouring object. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Two modes. Block mode: ACTION1/2 move both cyan blocks up/down 4, ACTION3/4 apart/together (mirrored); clicking a marker arms (blocks -> color_1 players, marker -> active 11).
Armed mode: ACTION1-4 move the active marker 4; clicking a marker switches active; clicking a player goes back to blocks; ACTION5 no-op.
Hypothesis result: marker 'gone' vs 'x,y' under ACTION6 is just renaming. Names are type_color_rank sorted by (y,x), and block_* take ranks 0,1. Ranks shift when bars or players appear.
wall_0 bar width = floor(3(n+1)/7), n = actions since level start (hidden). Tracked with full-state continuity; fallback is the smallest n that fits the bar.
Unconfirmed: the invisible maze cells {(14,38),(6,18),(38,14)} come from failed moves (markers also block). 30/30 with state; 17/30 without it because of the counter.
